title: Multi-layer perceptron on a nine-protein serum panel detects breast cancer
summary: A multi-layer perceptron derived cutoffs for a nine-protein serum mass spectrometry panel; in 465 samples (222 breast cancer, 243 healthy) sensitivity was 83.3%, specificity 88.1%, accuracy 85.8% and AUC 0.8526, versus 77.0% accuracy for the three-protein signature. Samples are retrospective case-control and the algorithm was fixed from a development cohort of 502.
ai_technology: Multi-layer perceptron binary classification neural network on nine serum proteins

evidence.tested: Separate validation set of 465 serum samples.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
